title: Existing leads, follow-ups and re-engagement
note: This source discovers nothing. It works the pipeline that the other nine produced, and it may recommend no contact at all.
objective: Convert existing prospect records into a disciplined, evidence-based outreach pipeline.
responsibilities: Which prospects should be paused or closed
Which new evidence changes a lead's priority
Which outreach patterns produce genuine business opportunities

review: Previous scores and reasons for qualification
source_of_truth.rule: Do not invent prior conversations, replies, messages, contact dates or consent. If communication history is unavailable, state that it cannot be verified.

status_semantics.rule: Retain the statuses the interface needs, but define their meanings consistently.
status_semantics.applied: A real application submitted to a project or role (Source 07), never a generic sales message sent to a business.
status_semantics.hidden: A view flag, not a lifecycle state. It hides a lead from the default list without changing its qualification.
status_semantics.do_not_contact: Suppresses all future outreach, regardless of score.

steps: Verify the current record and business identity.
Check whether the opportunity is still relevant.
Determine whether the lead is eligible for another contact.
Update the score only when supported by new evidence.
Preserve the history of prior decisions.
rules: Do not increase scores merely because a lead has remained in the database for a long time.
Do not decrease a score solely because a message has not received a reply.

follow_up_eligibility: The contact channel and date are known
The prospect has not opted out
There is no explicit rejection that makes further contact inappropriate
No duplicate outreach is already pending
The follow-up is consistent with applicable laws and platform rules
There is a legitimate reason to contact the prospect again
eligibility_rule: If the previous message, contact date or status cannot be verified, recommend reviewing the record rather than assuming a follow-up is due.
follow_up_reasons: Answering a question the prospect asked
Responding to a new, relevant public requirement
Following up on a proposal at an agreed time
Offering a useful clarification about a proposed pilot

must: Address an outstanding question or provide a relevant next step
Include one clear question or action
must_not: Manufacture urgency or imply a deadline that does not exist
Use false claims about prior discussions
message_rules.interval_rule: Use reasonable intervals based on the previous interaction, any agreed follow-up date, the channel and applicable rules. Do not assume every lead should receive the same number of messages.
message_rules.first_contact_rule: If no prior interaction exists, create a first-contact message rather than labeling it a follow-up.

reply_rule: Do not classify an ambiguous response as positive buying intent. Extract the prospect's actual requirements and questions without adding unsupported assumptions.

commercial_qualification.unknown_rule: Mark undisclosed details as unknown. Do not guess a budget, deadline or purchasing authority from company size or industry.
commercial_qualification.clarify_rule: Use direct clarification when an important qualification detail is missing.

reconsider_when: New evidence reveals a relevant requirement
The business publishes a suitable project request
A new decision-maker becomes publicly identifiable
The prospect previously invited a follow-up
A relevant service or portfolio example has become available
re_engagement.rule: Do not re-engage indefinitely without a credible reason. A closed-lost opportunity may be reconsidered when circumstances materially change, but retain the prior outcome and explain the new evidence.

current_service_fit.question: Does the lead still match a deliverable service?

evidence_of_need_or_intent.question: Is there evidence of need or buying intent?

engagement_progress.question: How far has the conversation actually progressed?

recency_and_next_action.question: Is the next action recent and relevant?

scoring.gate: Interpret the score together with the lifecycle status. A high-scoring lead that opted out must never be contacted. Message opens and profile views are not purchase intent; replies, explicit requests, agreed meetings and defined requirements are stronger.

missing_value_rule: Do not invent historical data. Use unknown or null where appropriate.

rules: Address an outstanding question or provide a relevant next step
Include one clear question or action
message_generation.sending: Do not send messages automatically unless an authorized sending workflow explicitly permits it. Human approval stays available before any external communication.

funnel_rule: Evaluate conversion by source, service, evidence level and outreach approach. Never optimise for lead volume, message volume or vanity metrics at the expense of relevant conversations.
operating_principle: The goal is not to keep contacting every lead. It is to advance suitable opportunities, learn from real responses, and stop contacting prospects when further outreach is inappropriate.

quantity_policy.rule: No numeric limit. Review every eligible lead; recommend no contact where contact is not justified.
